plugins.description: Reel Time: /fish opens the cozy fishing game, /reel-time:lake points it at your own lake; when Claude finishes, a bell rings and a golden fish bites. It only sends 'working' and 'done' to your private save; never your prompts or Claude's answers.

description: Reel Time, the cozy fishing game that runs beside Claude: a golden fish bites when your answer is ready.
